1.3.title: Read prompt + validated output schema
1.3.description: Create src/lib/ai/read.prompt.md (versioned header) and src/lib/ai/read-schema.ts. Read output (Zod): seen string[] (<=8 short noun phrases), doing string (one observable present-tense sentence <=20 words, no evaluation, no names), artefact enum worksheet|book|writing|drawing|build|nature|cooking|screen|other, printedText string (<=12 words: a visible title/lesson/page header only), peopleVisible int>=0, confidence high|low. Prompt rules: describe only what is visible; never name a skill, subject, outcome, age or quality; never guess identity; transcribe headers only, never page body (copyright); low confidence -> doing ''. Export parseReadOutput(raw): ReadOutput|null (invalid/refusal -> null, never invented), and a prompt-section builder that enrich.ts can splice into its existing call. Unit tests for parsing, truncation, refusal.
